video_title: Chaotic NBA Opening Week Reaction: Key Injuries & New Contenders? + Major Beef

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams suffers significant lower left leg injury against Clippers
quotes.excerpt: severe lower left leg injury. He got tangled up. Really he just landed on it.
quotes.quote: Terrible injury to the Oklahoma City Thunder wing Jalen Williams tonight in a game against the LA Clippers right at the end of the game. Severe lower left leg injury. He got tangled up. Really he just landed on it. He was on the left wing, the ball swung to him. Chris Dunn was guarding him. He beat Chris Dunn off the dribble. Derrick Jones Jr. came over to bring help defense on the play. In my view, there was nothing sinister about it. He just came over and challenged, and they made contact. It was a foul, and Jalen landed, he got his left leg underneath him, and he suffered a terrible injury.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams' injury is reminiscent of Gordon Hayward's opening night injury
quotes.excerpt: Unfortunately, very reminiscent of Gordon Hayward's injury on a similar play also in October.
quotes.quote: Unfortunately, very reminiscent of Gordon Hayward's injury on a similar play also in October. That year was opening night. His first game as a Celtic. He was an alley-oop play. That game was in Cleveland. I was there that night, and I can remember vividly the way the arena felt, the way the Celtics locker room felt. I stood outside the Celtics locker room that night as Gordon was getting evaluated. Unfortunately, I was also there for the Paul George injury, which was a few years earlier in Las Vegas during a Team USA intrasquad scrimmage. Both situations were almost exactly the same as this Jalen Williams situation in that it was a freak play on a drive to the basket that resulted in an awkward landing.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's reaction to Jalen Williams' injury
quotes.excerpt: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, as you would imagine, his response was exactly correct in that it is a very unfortunate thing.
quotes.quote: That is one of the things that Shai Gilgeous-Alexander said after the game. Shai, as you would imagine, his response was exactly correct in that it is a very unfortunate thing. It was sickening, and it is also a part of the game. And that is the case. I will just say that in all those situations, the thing that I can remember is how visceral it affected all of the players around the guy on the floor. In the case of the Team USA scrimmage, they stopped the game. They couldn't finish it.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Derrick Jones Jr. checked on Jalen Williams after the play
quotes.excerpt: Derrick Jones Jr. took a shot on the play too and some of the Clippers players were coming over.
quotes.quote: By the way, Derrick Jones Jr. took a shot on the play too and some of the Clippers players were coming over to check on him. And then they just saw what happened and they turned their back. This is going to be a very difficult thing for any team to handle. The Thunder are a particularly close unit, a particularly close team, and somewhat still a young team, so not exactly grizzled veterans.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams likely needs surgery for his injury
quotes.excerpt: He will probably have surgery tonight, if not tonight, very soon after.
quotes.quote: He will probably have surgery tonight, if not tonight, very soon after. In the case of Paul George, he did have surgery that night. In the case of Gordon Hayward, I think he might have flown back to Boston and had surgery there. The most important thing on this is what sort of ligament damage there is. Obviously, it's very clearly a broken bone, where the bone is broken, but the ligament damage will be key. In the case of Paul George and in the case of Gordon Hayward, both of them obviously missed the following year, the rest of the year, the following year, and both of them returned very strong. They recovered. So, bone injury, it heals. It just takes time, and there's no reason to believe that Jalen Williams won't return very strong.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams is protected by his contract
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Williams is in the second year of a five-year max contract. He's protected financially.
quotes.quote: Both Paul George and Gordon Hayward were in at the beginning of big contracts. I don't know if it was quite the max for Gordon Hayward, but I think it was close to it. It might have been a brand new max contract. Paul George had just signed a max contract with the Pacers. And so they were protected. And so you always feel for the player to make sure he's protected. Jalen Williams is in the second year of a five-year max contract. He's protected financially, so he will be protected on the ability to, he won't, whatever this does to his career, he's going to be protected. I always care about that. I want to make sure the player's okay. So he's protected, so that's really good.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder are a deep team, but Jalen Williams is a key player
quotes.excerpt: The Thunder are arguably the deepest team in the league. It feels a little bit uncouth to analyze.
quotes.quote: The Thunder are arguably the deepest team in the league. It feels a little bit uncouth to analyze what happens now, but that is the job. They are, you know, arguably the deepest team in the league. They had a lot of success last year. They were a 60-win team without him for a majority of the season. It is a gut blow because he is their second or third best player, and you know, this is a highly competitive situation in the league right now. They needed, the difference between them winning the championship two years ago and losing it last year, arguably, was Jalen Williams because he wasn't right last year with the hamstring injury.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Suggs suffers right knee injury
quotes.excerpt: Within five minutes of the injury, Jalen Suggs of the Orlando Magic went down with a right knee injury.
quotes.quote: Also, in the crazy set of circumstances, within five minutes of the injury, Jalen Suggs of the Orlando Magic went down with a right knee injury, a pretty scary looking right knee injury at the Garden. And it was crazy that two different situations, like, they, you know, Jalen was being stretchered off and Suggs was being taken off like within minutes of each other, very similar scenes. And, you know, if you watch the play on Suggs, his right knee sort of bends back when he's taking off for a dunk or a layup or whatever, and you're hoping that that is a hyperextension and not an ACL.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder have a disabled player exception available
quotes.excerpt: The Thunder have the ability to apply for a disabled player exception, which they will certainly get.
quotes.quote: The Thunder have the ability to apply for a disabled player exception, which they will certainly get. Let's be honest here, the Thunder are not, they cannot replace him. No one will replace him with what they have on their roster with AJ Mitchell. You know, he becomes a very important piece right now. And, you know, the fact that they had to trade away multiple wings over the summer, Aaron Wiggins and Lou Dort, you know, it comes into play for sure. But this means, you know, AJ Mitchell will have to have a big season, and now Cason Wallace, who was just rewarded with a huge contract, you know, those guys will be needed. And you also could see some opportunities for Davis Bertans, who actually I think got his first NBA basket tonight.
